line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.

verification.scope: Fresh baseline hash, filtered source difference and logical line check; prior compiler controls cited in decision. No production change or new runtime test.

decision: All twelve live changes coincide with native destruction or capture ownership counterexamples in the pending register. R2109/2111/2114 cover DC acquisition, color callback and release. R2115/2118/2119/2120/2121/2123 guard distinct continuations: original faults, delivers notification after destruction, or releases foreign capture. R2126/2127/2139 cover paint, text drawing and SETTEXT after destruction. Pinning storage does not keep spwnd attached after WM_NCDESTROY. Removing individual guards previously reproduced the recorded failures. No new branch or shim.
